title: 第一卷 第20章 强吻第一卷 第21章 震惊的大小姐
slug: 逆主马奴我以阴阳证大道
lines: 王龙跟秦明岚面对面，距离不过一臂之遥。
秦明岚能清晰地看见王龙脸上纵横的皱纹，以及那双浑浊却闪烁着精光的眼睛。
她有些不自在，下意识往后缩了缩。
“老东西，你离本小姐远一点。”
王龙连忙点头，往后挪了半尺。
“大小姐放心，老奴只是为了方便引导灵气，绝无他意。”
秦明岚哼了一声，闭上眼睛，为了变强，这都不是事。
她也想为洛寒衣分担，为这个家。
“开始吧。”
王龙深吸一口气，缓缓伸出双手，掌心朝上，放在两人之间。
“大小姐，请将手放在老奴手上。”
秦明岚睁开眼，看着他那双布满老茧和伤疤的手，眼中闪过一丝嫌弃，但还是把手放了上去。
掌心相贴，触感分明。
王龙的手粗糙滚烫，秦明岚的手细腻微凉。
两只手放在一起，对比鲜明得有些刺眼。
秦明岚咬着嘴唇，努力忽略掌心传来的异样触感，闭上眼睛，催促着。
“然后呢？”
王龙也闭上眼睛，沉声道。
“大小姐请运转功法，老奴会为你引导灵气，帮助您疏通经脉。”
秦明岚依言运转《阴阳合欢诀》入门篇，体内灵气开始缓缓流动。
刚开始还算顺畅，可灵气运行到膻中穴时，忽然像是撞上了一堵墙，怎么都冲不过去。
秦明岚眉头紧皱，额头上渗出细密的汗珠。
“老东西，有点难，本小姐冲不过去……”
“别急，大小姐，请放松。”
王龙的声音平静而温和，带着一种奇异的安抚力量。
“老奴现在引导灵气进入您的体内，您不要抵抗，顺着老奴的引导走。”
秦明岚点点头，努力放松身体。
王龙闭上眼，催动混沌开天圣体，同时运转《阴阳合欢诀》。
一缕精纯的灵气从他掌心涌出，顺着两人相贴的手掌，缓缓渡入。
那缕灵气虽然微弱，却带着一种奇异的力量，温和而坚韧，像是一把钝刀，在秦明岚堵塞的经脉中慢慢开凿。
秦明岚浑身一颤，感觉到一股温热的暖流从掌心涌入，沿着手臂一路向上，最终汇聚在膻中穴。
暖流流转，所过之处，经脉像是被温水冲刷过一般，舒展开来。
content_en:
Wang Long and Qin Minglan were face to face, only an arm's length apart.
Qin Minglan could clearly see the vertical and horizontal wrinkles on Wang Long's face, as well as his cloudy but shining eyes.
She felt a little uncomfortable and shrank back subconsciously.
"Old guy, stay away from this lady."
Wang Long nodded quickly and moved back half a foot.
"Don't worry, young lady, this old slave is just for the convenience of guiding spiritual energy, and has no other intentions."
Qin Minglan snorted and closed his eyes. In order to become stronger, this was nothing.
She also wanted to share the burden for Luo Hanyi and this family.
"Let's get started."
Wang Long took a deep breath, slowly stretched out his hands, palms facing up, and placed them between the two of them.
"Miss, please put your hand on the old slave's hand."
Qin Minglan opened her eyes and looked at his hands covered with calluses and scars. A trace of disgust flashed in her eyes, but she still put her hands up.
The palms touch each other and the touch is distinct.
Wang Long's hands were rough and hot, while Qin Minglan's hands were delicate and slightly cool.
Putting the two hands together, the contrast was so sharp that it was dazzling.
Qin Minglan bit her lip, trying to ignore the strange touch in her palm, closing her eyes and urging.
"Then what?"
Wang Long also closed his eyes and said solemnly.
"Miss, please use the technique. The old slave will guide you with spiritual energy and help you clear your meridians."
Qin Minglan followed the instructions and ran the introductory chapter of "Yin Yang He Huan Jue", and the spiritual energy in his body began to flow slowly.
It was smooth at first, but when the spiritual energy reached the Tanzhong point, it suddenly seemed like it hit a wall and couldn't get past it.
Qin Minglan frowned, and beads of sweat broke out on his forehead.
"Old thing, it's a bit difficult. I can't rush through it..."
"Don't worry, Miss, please relax."
Wang Lung's voice was calm and gentle, with a strange soothing power.
"The old slave is now guiding the spiritual energy into your body. Don't resist, just follow the old slave's guidance."
Qin Minglan nodded and tried to relax his body.
Wang Long closed his eyes, activated the Chaos Opening Heaven Holy Body, and simultaneously operated the "Yin Yang Jue Jue".
A wisp of pure spiritual energy surged out from his palm and slowly flowed in along the palms of the two people that were touching each other.
Although that ray of spiritual energy was weak, it carried a strange power, gentle and tough, like a dull knife, slowly digging into Qin Minglan's blocked meridians.
Qin Minglan shuddered and felt a warm current pouring in from the palm of his hand, all the way up his arm, and finally gathered at the Tanzhong point.
The warm current circulates, and wherever it passes, the meridians stretch out as if they have been washed by warm water.
